en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large classical-style university building with a symmetrical façade, mansard roof and many windows. It stands in front of a mountain backdrop with terraced slopes and fortification-like structures. Leafless trees line the street in front. Printed caption at the bottom reads in French about Grenoble and the university, with the initials 'LL' on the right and the number '99' on the left.
